title.narrative: Delivery of sustainable and quality comprehensive eye health care at primary and

description.narrative: The ‘Delivery of sustainable and quality comprehensive eye health care at primary and secondary levels, ensuring it is integrated into the existing health system across Gamo, Gofa, Derashe, Konso, Alle and Dawuro (GGDKA-D) in South Nations, Nationalities and People’s Region (SNNPR), Ethiopia’ project aims to reduce the prevalence of avoidable blindness and visual impairment due to trachoma, cataract and refractive error. The implementing partners are Orbis Ethiopia, Gamo, Gofa, Konso and Dawuro Zonal Department of Finance and Economic Development. The objective is to focus on establishing quality eye care services accessible to all and build positive health behaviour and practices to seek eye care services when needed. Orbis Ireland will implement the WHO-recommended SAFE strategy to eliminate trachoma. The key activities include the provision of surgeries and antibiotics, enhancing Facial Cleanliness and Environmental Improvement components, building the knowledge and skills of health workers and teachers, ensuring a comprehensive eye service, and reaching marginalised and vulnerable groups.
